hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; pattern='(^|[;&|]|[[:space:]])(git|[^[:space:]]*/git)([[:space:]]|$)'; if echo "$cmd" | grep -iE "$pattern" >/dev/null; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git commands are disabled in this project (see CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md)."}}'; else echo '{}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r fp; root=$(readlink -f -- "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"); if [ -z "$fp" ]; then echo '{}'; exit 0; fi; case "$fp" in /*) target="$fp" ;; *) target="$root/$fp" ;; esac; real=$(readlink -f -- "$target" 2>/dev/null || echo "$target"); case "$real" in "$root"|"$root"/*) echo '{}' ;; *) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Writing outside the project directory is disabled for this project."}}' ;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: Checking file path is inside the project
